primitive.panel: <FramePanel id> — one atomic panel; JurnlFamilyShell lifts existing child-screen panels automatically

algorithm: Greedy, in order. A panel joins the current screen if used + gap + height ≤ available (+0.5px tolerance); otherwise it moves WHOLE to the next screen. Screen 1 has the full content rect; continuation screens subtract the caption height and one gap.

rules.ATOMIC: A panel is never split across screens.
rules.ORDER: Panel order is preserved; every panel appears on exactly one screen.
rules.OVERSIZE_PANEL: A panel taller than a whole screen gets a screen of its own, is flagged data-jrn-oversize, is clamped to the rect and scrolls inside itself (overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain). Its natural height is re-measured from scrollHeight so the flag is stable.
rules.ZERO_HEIGHT: Zero-height slots (sheets rendering into the overlay host, empty conditionals) take no space and no gap.
rules.OFFSCREEN_PANELS: Stay laid out at the same width so they remain measurable: position absolute, visibility hidden, pointer-events none, aria-hidden, inert.
rules.REPAGINATION: ResizeObserver on the content rect and on every slot, document.fonts.ready, and a change in the panel id list. The screen holding the panel being read is kept (clampScreen anchors on the first panel of the current screen).
rules.KEYBOARD: While a field inside the rect has focus and the rect shrinks (software keyboard), pagination freezes; it recomputes on blur.
rules.STATE: Presentation state only (FrameProvider, keyed by pathname): no route, no query param, no history entry. A route change starts at screen 1.
rules.CONTINUATION_CAPTION: “{FAMILY} · CONTINUED” at the top of screens 2+.
rules.FORWARD: NEXT control at the right end of the composition edge (data-jrn-trigger="frame-next"); absent on the last screen; screen marks at the left end.
rules.BODY_SCROLL: Never. Internal scroll only for an OVERSIZE panel.

unit_tests: tests/jurnlMobileComposition.test.tsx (24 tests: fit, whole-panel move, 3+ screens, continuation height, oversize, zero-height, anchor clamp; frame + archetype on 13 roots; nav contract)
